headline: Sensex and Nifty Open Lower as IT Stocks Decline; HDFC Bank Announces CEO Transition

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty 50 opened in negative territory following global cues.
IT sector stocks are leading the sectoral declines, weighing heavily on the broader market.
Market volatility is expected to persist ahead of the upcoming monthly F&O expiry.
Global factors, including oil prices trading below $115, are influencing investor sentiment.
whatHappening: HDFC Bank announced a leadership change with Anup Bagchi taking over from Sashidhar Jagdishan.
Mankind Pharma is seeing a sharp rise in futures open interest among F&O stocks.
The Nifty 50 is trading near the 22,700 level after an initial drop in early trade.
Investors are tracking IPO grey market premiums and subscription statuses for EAAA India and BLS Polymers.
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened lower on Tuesday, with the Sensex dropping 200 points and IT stocks leading the sectoral decline. HDFC Bank is in focus following a major leadership transition, while Mankind Pharma shows increased futures activity. Markets are expected to remain volatile as investors look toward the monthly F&O expiry and Q2 corporate results.
